newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in directionless after-hours trade on Wednesday, as most individual investors retreated to sidelines, discouraged by recent static prices, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.8 yen per kg lower to 0.3 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark June was up 0.1 yen at 145.9 yen. Volume was 3,320 lots.
During the day, prices moved sideways as the market failed to respond to the yen's further slip against the dollar.
"The only market feature was some position-adjustment ahead of the spot expiry next Monday," a trader said.
